normalization: Every literal top-level changelog bullet was ingested from the frozen blob. Literal entries are scope-classified here and reconciled many-to-one to the 248 reviewed functional ledger records; the normalized ledger remains the authoritative per-fix browser disposition/task map.
classification_method: Deterministic source-intake classifier run inside the GitHub connector over the full frozen CHANGELOG content; every bullet receives exactly one scope disposition and primary phase family. Detailed browser dispositions/target WP IDs remain in UPSTREAM_FIX_LEDGER.json.
reproducibility: p01_tools.py intake verifies the same Git blob SHA when a full checkout is available; this package records the connector-side census because the sandbox cannot materialize the complete upstream checkout.
notes: A release/publication/test-harness bullet can contain playback terminology; the literal scope class is an intake label, not an implementation verdict.
Older contradictory behavior is resolved by SUPERSESSION_DECISIONS.md and current upstream TASKS revision 71.
No unseen/local upstream changes are inferred.
